items.title: SCP Breach
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Secure, contain and protect the breach! The monsters have broken out of their cages and are trying to escape! This skin pack features many creepy monsters to roleplay as and scare others with!

items.title: Ninja Class
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Become a master ninja with one of these skins! Protect your village from all sorts of evil monsters. A perfect skin pack for roleplaying with friends and creating a ninja world!

items.title: Horror Skyblock
items.creator: HeroPixels
items.description:
Play on a foggy day and survive the night on the spookiest Skyblock map.
Build your monster-proof Skyblock island!

+ New mobs!
+ Spooky music
+ Craftable witch broom
+ Nether & The End Skyblock
+ Halloween decorations
+ Play with friends!

items.title: Pink Palace
items.creator: BTWN Creations
items.description:
Rule in your own pink palace with your trusty unicorn steed. Walk through sparkling cherry blossom gardens and watch fireflies in the trees at night. Climb to the top of the abandoned tower or dive deep into the amethyst mines. This is your kingdom!

-Rideable unicorns
-Custom diamond, purpur, cherry wood and villager textures!
-4 Skins!
-By BTWN

items.title: K-Pop Champions
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Watch anime, eat, sleep and repeat! This is the new average lifestyle of these fashionistas teens. Be the champion of today's event and create stories to be remembered about! Taste the sweet candies at the anime festival and try new dance moves until you become the champion of the night.
+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Ultra Powerful Armor
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
Check out these Ultra Powerful Armor skins! Intimidating neon glow outfits for your journey!

- Glow skins
- Armor
- By KA Studios

items.title: Skyblock World
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Do you like Skyblock? Then this world is exactly what you are looking for!
Build from island to island and think carefully about how to use the few resources.

+Skyblock experience
+By FALL Studios

items.title: Halloween Village!
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Get ready for Halloween and explore a large, spooky village!

+ Fully furnished houses
+ Survival Spawn

items.title: Lucky Block Weapons
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
LUCKY BLOCK? WEAPONS? Yes, play your favorite lucky block mod with tons of CUSTOM weapons! Test your luck in this map as you get a chance to get 20 unique items. Summon lightning bolts with the war axe, heal your friend with the healer book, be a ninja with a cyber katana, and many more!

+ 20 OP lucky weapons!
+ 5 new and custom mobs!
+ Includes a secret bunker!

items.title: MC Animals
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
Do you love Minecraft creatures? Time to choose a fun animal for your next survival adventure!

+ Includes 10 skins

items.title: Mob Animatronics!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Fear-inducing Mob Animatronics have been seen haunting Minecraft!
Jump-scare and terrify your friends with this scary skin pack!

+ 1 free HD skin!

items.title: Ender Knights
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the dark ender side! Rule the end as an epic ender knight and vanquish all travelers from entering! Become one of the most fearful and powerful knights in any realm! No one will stand a chance against these armored warrior skins! Which skin will you swing your sword with? 

- 10 armored skins!
- Glowey skins!
- 1 free skin!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Realm Knights
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Do you ever feel like you were born in the wrong era? It's time to travel back to medieval times, grab your sword, and suit up! These knights have gathered from across the realm to fight the world's many evils- and they need you! Put on one of these skins and channel your inner swordsman as you travel through the world and duel the Ender Dragon.

~Classic knight designs

items.title: Spooky Mansion
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Do you dare to enter Spooky Mansion? It's time to gather courage and start your adventure at this scariest mansion. Explore the darkest parts of the house and underground base, fight monsters, and banish evil spirits. Be courageous to set foot in this house! 

+ Spooky models.
+ 6 Halloween skins.
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios
